The '''Light Bending ''Ord Pedrovia'' Podracer''' was a variant of the [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] piloted by [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]].

==Characteristics==
It was very similar to Gasgano's podracer, except this particular model bent the light around it to add a shimmering, ghostly effect.

==History==
Some time during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was intensifying, at least one [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was known to have acquired a podracer such as this one.

==Behind the scenes==
This vehicle is given out to players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' who redeem 'Recruit a Friend Tokens.' These tokens are awarded for inviting people to play ''Star Wars Galaxies''.
